data.key: Hunter Animal Companion Trick ~ Chameleon Step
data.name: Chameleon Step
data.description: The ranger can move up to twice his speed as a move action. The ranger does not take any penalty on Stealth checks for movement during this move. This move provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.
